subject.title: [Feature]: Improve Workspace Skill Loading: Add Frontmatter Parsing Error Visibility and Validation for SKILL.md

question: Should malformed workspace `SKILL.md` diagnostics be accepted as a new `skills lint` validation surface first, or must normal `skills list`/`skills check`/`skills.status`/Web output also report skipped candidates before this issue can close?
rationale: Current main still lacks diagnostics, and the open PR is plausible but intentionally narrower than parts of the requested product surface.

options.title: Fix and land lint-first diagnostics
options.body: Repair the open PR's runtime-parity gap, document the scope clearly, and close this issue only if maintainers accept lint as the first sufficient user-visible diagnostic surface.

options.title: Require normal status/UI visibility
options.body: Keep the issue open until skipped-candidate diagnostics are threaded through `skills.status`, normal CLI output, and the Web console in addition to any lint command.

options.title: Pause the lint command direction
options.body: Reject or pause the standalone lint command and ask for a smaller status/check diagnostic design before adding a new public CLI command.

recommendation.title: Fix and land lint-first diagnostics
recommendation.body: Repair the open PR's runtime-parity gap, document the scope clearly, and close this issue only if maintainers accept lint as the first sufficient user-visible diagnostic surface.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the best available routing candidate from the inspected parser/docs/current-main history for deciding the public diagnostic surface and wording.
